scope: Explicit variant subset. Selected variants only; no whole-suite coverage claim. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts use parsed strictness and unchanged harness sources. Parse/early-negative tests use native syntax validation without evaluation. Unsupported module execution, agents, lowering and runtime operations, as well as harness errors, crashes and timeouts remain in the totals. Module requests retain source, defer and evaluation phases. Deferred namespaces trigger synchronous evaluation on string operations except then; asynchronous transitive dependencies evaluate eagerly. The loader provides the Test262 module-source host representation and AbstractModuleSource intrinsic; JavaScript source requests reject with SyntaxError. JSON, attributes, top-level await and direct eval are enabled. Text/bytes and undiscovered relative specifiers remain unsupported.
variantPolicy: Every explicit manifest entry validated against pinned paths, source hashes and syntaxVariants; raw/strict/sloppy/module flags retained; fixture files excluded. Syntax-negative files precede execution files, preserving file order within each lane. No unsupported or failed variants excluded from the denominator.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
